definitions.explanation: Officially calling people together for a meeting, assembly, or duty. Often used for legislative sessions, military conscription, and formal gatherings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{召集|しょうしゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{召集|しょうしゅう}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Everyone was summoned for an emergency meeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦時中|せんじちゅう}→戦時中：28629_senjichuu⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{召集|しょうしゅう}{令状|れいじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}った→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧。
examples.english: During wartime, many young people received draft notices.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧{召集|しょうしゅう} (convocation of parliament)
- {召集|しょうしゅう}{令状|れいじょう} (draft notice, call-up papers)
- ⟦{臨時|りんじ}→臨時：04092_rinji⟧{召集|しょうしゅう} (extraordinary convocation)
- {召集|しょうしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ (issue a summons)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{招集|しょうしゅう} is a homograph with the same reading but a different first character. {召集|しょうしゅう} specifically refers to official, authoritative summoning (parliament, military), while {招集|しょうしゅう} is broader and can mean calling any group together. In practice, both are often used interchangeably in non-legal contexts.
